sections.title: Reversible computation and uniform circuit families
sections.question: How does an explicit classical uniform circuit family become a clean reversible family?
sections.exit: Gate-list translation,compute invariant,copy/uncompute and polynomial uniformity/cost proof.
sections.worked_case: NAND,half-adder,aliased controls,constants and direct taps with arbitrary output bits.
sections.boundary: Topologically ordered finite Boolean circuit;zero initialized workspace;bounded host/native guards;not a Turing/optimal compiler theorem.
